name: Jiahui Cheng
bio: I completed my PhD in Computational Science and Engineering at Georgia Tech. My doctoral research focused on data-driven discovery of differential equations, binary classification, and dynamical systems. Before Georgia Tech, I studied computing and applied mathematics at the University of Science and Technology of China.
